text_blocks.snippet: The Mega Charizard X ex is a prominent Stage 2 Fire-type Pokémon card from the Phantasmal Flames (ME02) set in the Pokémon Trading Card Game, featuring 360 HP and the powerful Inferno X attack.
snippet_highlighted_words: a prominent Stage 2 Fire-type Pokémon card from the Phantasmal Flames (ME02) set in the Pokémon Trading Card Game

list.snippet: Stage & HP: Stage 2 Pokémon (evolves from Charmeleon), 360 HP
Attack: Inferno X (90×) – Discard any amount of Fire Energy from among your Pokémon; this attack deals 90 damage for each card discarded.
Weakness / Resistance / Retreat Cost: Water (×2) / None / 2 Energy.
Double Rare (#013/094): Standard holographic version from Phantasmal Flames.

Special Illustration Rare (#125/094): Illustrated by takuyoa, with raw/ungraded copies selling around $535 to $1,000+, and PSA 10 graded copies fetching roughly $1,588 on the Mega Charizard X ex #125 Price Guide. You can view full marketplace data on TCGplayer.
